columns.comment: DQ run id DQ-yyyymmdd (the as-of date it evaluated).
columns.name: run_id

columns.comment: DQ rule id <table>:<rule>, e.g. pay_payment_message:key_unique, pay_payment_message:x:landing_ties_to_cash_flow.
columns.name: rule_id

columns.comment: Layer the rule was evaluated on: bronze, shared or silver.
columns.name: layer

columns.comment: As-of date of the DQ run (from the run id; the grain date).
columns.name: run_date

columns.comment: First day of the month of the run (joins fact_dq_score_monthly.month).
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Layer-qualified table evaluated, e.g. bronze.pay_payment_message.
columns.name: table_name

columns.comment: Table name without the layer.
columns.name: base_table_name

columns.comment: Column(s) the rule checks (comma-separated; * = row / cross-table rule).
columns.name: column_name

columns.comment: DQ dimension: completeness, validity, uniqueness, timeliness or consistency.
columns.name: dimension

columns.comment: Rule kind, e.g. key_present, key_unique, required, valid_values, parent_exists, golden_key, freshness, cross_table.
columns.name: rule_kind

columns.comment: What the rule checks (DQ catalogue).
columns.name: rule_description

columns.comment: Rule expression as documented in the DQ catalogue.
columns.name: rule_expr

columns.comment: Where the rule came from: generated (from the table spec) or hand_written (cross-table consistency rule).
columns.name: rule_origin

columns.comment: Grain the rule is evaluated at: row or table.
columns.name: rule_grain

columns.comment: Rule severity: error, warn or info.
columns.name: severity

columns.comment: True for blocking rules - failing rows are quarantined out of silver.
columns.name: is_blocking

columns.comment: Action on failure: none, deduplicate (rows removed by business-key de-duplication) or flag (rows kept and flagged).
columns.name: action

columns.comment: Rows evaluated by the rule.
columns.name: total_rows

columns.comment: Rows failing the rule (for deduplicate rules = duplicate rows removed).
columns.name: failed_rows

columns.comment: total_rows - failed_rows.
columns.name: passed_rows

columns.comment: Rows removed by de-duplication (failed_rows of deduplicate rules; 0 otherwise).
columns.name: deduplicated_rows

columns.comment: Share of rows passing (fraction 0-1).
columns.name: pass_rate

columns.comment: Failure rate tolerated before the rule fails (fraction; 0 = no failure tolerated).
columns.name: threshold

columns.comment: Result: pass, warn or fail.
columns.name: status

columns.comment: True when the status is warn or fail (Rules Failed).
columns.name: is_failed

columns.comment: True when the status is fail.
columns.name: is_hard_fail

columns.comment: Sample keys of failing rows, comma-separated (null when none).
columns.name: sample_keys_text

columns.comment: Extra detail as JSON text, e.g. {removed_by_batch: {PAY_20260617_R: 3966}}.
columns.name: detail

columns.comment: Demo storyline the rule result belongs to (e.g. 12 = payments replay); null otherwise.
columns.name: storyline_no

columns.comment: True for the latest DQ run.
columns.name: is_latest_run

comment: Rule-level data-quality results of the DQ run (DQ-20260930, as of 30-Sep-2026): one row per DQ rule evaluated on a layer-qualified table (bronze, shared or silver) with the rule definition from the DQ catalogue, its dimension, severity, blocking flag and action, rows evaluated / failed, pass rate, threshold and status (pass / warn / fail). The drill-down behind fact_dq_score_monthly's latest month - e.g. pay_payment_message:key_unique on bronze: 3,966 replayed messages of batch PAY_20260617_R removed by de-duplication (storyline 12), silver passes. Grain: one row per DQ run per rule per layer.
